reason: V0.1A passed compile and frozen-contract guards but accepted any JSON object returned with HTTP 200. A response without valid blockDetails.blockTime then failed outside the retry loop. V0.1B changes only semantic response validation/retry behavior.

unchanged_scientific_contract.boundary_selection: first block whose blockTime is >= target, with previous block strictly before target
unchanged_scientific_contract.schema_candidate_gate: oracle-related JSON key path OR oracle-related action/type label

transport_only_changes.valid_success_shape: top-level JSON object with type=blockDetails and nested blockDetails object containing integer-convertible blockTime
transport_only_changes.invalid_http200_json_policy: treat as transport-semantic failure; retry the same requested height under unchanged backoff; never substitute another height
transport_only_changes.http_429_policy: respect Retry-After when present; otherwise sleep at least 65 seconds; retry same height
transport_only_changes.scan_partition: same deterministic contiguous partition of the frozen 301 heights
transport_only_changes.aggregation: fail closed unless all 301 unique frozen heights are present and contiguous
